versos.grego: Δικαιωθέντες οὖν ἐκ πίστεως εἰρήνην ἔχωμεν πρὸς τὸν Θεὸν διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ,

controles.web: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
controles.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
controles.livre: Portanto, agora que somos justificados pela fé, tenhamos paz com Deus por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: δι’ οὗ καὶ τὴν προσαγωγὴν ἐσχήκαμεν τῇ πίστει εἰς τὴν χάριν ταύτην ἐν ᾗ ἑστήκαμεν, καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐπ’ ἐλπίδι τῆς δόξης τοῦ Θεοῦ.

controles.web: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
controles.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
controles.livre: Por meio dele também temos acesso pela fé a esta graça, na qual estamos firmes, e nos alegramos na esperança da glória de Deus.

versos.grego: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμεθα ἐν ταῖς θλίψεσιν, εἰδότες ὅτι ἡ θλῖψις ὑπομονὴν κατεργάζεται,

controles.web: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering works perseverance;
controles.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
controles.livre: E não somente isso , mas também nos alegramos nas tribulações, sabendo que a tribulação produz paciência;

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ὑπομονὴ δοκιμήν, ἡ δὲ δοκιμὴ ἐλπίδα·

controles.web: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:
controles.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
controles.livre: a paciência produz experiência,  e a experiência produz esperança.

versos.grego: ἡ δὲ ἐλπὶς οὐ καταισχύνει, ὅτι ἡ ἀγάπη τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐκκέχυται ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ἡμῶν διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου τοῦ δοθέντος ἡμῖν.

controles.web: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.
controles.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
controles.livre: E a esperança não frustra, porque o amor de Deus está derramado em nossos corações pelo Espírito Santo que nos foi dado.

versos.grego: ἔτι γὰρ Χριστὸς ὄντων ἡμῶν ἀσθενῶν ἔτι κατὰ καιρὸν ὑπὲρ ἀσεβῶν ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.
controles.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
controles.livre: Pois quando ainda éramos fracos, Cristo morreu a seu tempo pelos ímpios.

versos.grego: μόλις γὰρ ὑπὲρ δικαίου τις ἀποθανεῖται· ὑπὲρ γὰρ τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ τάχα τις καὶ τολμᾷ ἀποθανεῖν·

controles.web: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.
controles.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
controles.livre: Ora, dificilmente alguém morre por um justo, ainda que talvez alguém possa ousar morrer por uma boa pessoa.

versos.grego: συνίστησιν δὲ τὴν ἑαυτοῦ ἀγάπην εἰς ἡμᾶς ὁ Θεὸς ὅτι ἔτι ἁμαρτωλῶν ὄντων ἡμῶν Χριστὸς ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἀπέθανεν.

controles.web: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
controles.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
controles.livre: Mas Deus prova o seu amor por nós através de Cristo haver morrido por nós, quando ainda éramos pecadores.

versos.grego: πολλῷ οὖν μᾶλλον δικαιωθέντες νῦν ἐν τῷ αἵματι αὐτοῦ σωθησόμεθα δι’ αὐτοῦ ἀπὸ τῆς ὀργῆς.

controles.web: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.
controles.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
controles.livre: Por isso, muito mais agora, que já somos justificados por seu sangue, seremos por ele salvos da ira.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ ἐχθροὶ ὄντες κατηλλάγημεν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ θανάτου τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ, πολλῷ μᾶλλον καταλλαγέντες σωθησόμεθα ἐν τῇ ζωῇ αὐτοῦ·

controles.web: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.
controles.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
controles.livre: Pois, se quando éramos inimigos, fomos reconciliados com Deus pela morte do seu Filho, muito mais, tendo sido reconciliados, seremos salvos pela sua vida.

versos.grego: οὐ μόνον δέ, ἀλλὰ καὶ καυχώμενοι ἐν τῷ Θεῷ διὰ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ, δι’ οὗ νῦν τὴν καταλλαγὴν ἐλάβομεν.

controles.web: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
controles.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
controles.livre: E não somente isso , mas também nos alegramos em Deus por meio do nosso Senhor Jesus Cristo, por quem agora recebemos a reconciliação.

versos.grego: Διὰ τοῦτο ὥσπερ δι’ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἡ ἁμαρτία εἰς τὸν κόσμον εἰσῆλθεν, καὶ διὰ τῆς ἁμαρτίας ὁ θάνατος, καὶ οὕτως εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους ὁ θάνατος διῆλθεν, ἐφ’ ᾧ πάντες ἥμαρτον·

controles.web: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.
controles.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
controles.livre: Portanto, assim como por um homem o pecado entrou no mundo, e pelo pecado a morte, assim também a morte passou a todos os seres humanos, porque todos pecaram.

versos.grego: ἄχρι γὰρ νόμου ἁμαρτία ἦν ἐν κόσμῳ, ἁμαρτία δὲ οὐκ ἐλλογεῖται μὴ ὄντος νόμου·

controles.web: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.
controles.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
controles.livre: Pois, antes da Lei, o pecado já existia no mundo; porém, quando não há Lei, o pecado não é considerado.

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ ἐβασίλευσεν ὁ θάνατος ἀπὸ Ἀδὰμ μέχρι Μωϋσέως καὶ ἐπὶ τοὺς μὴ ἁμαρτήσαντας ἐπὶ τῷ ὁμοιώματι τῆς παραβάσεως Ἀδάμ, ὅς ἐστιν τύπος τοῦ μέλλοντος.

controles.web: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.
controles.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam’s transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
controles.livre: Mas a morte reinou desde Adão até Moisés, até sobre aqueles que não pecaram à semelhança da transgressão de Adão, o qual era uma figura daquele que estava para vir.

versos.grego: Ἀλλ’ οὐχ ὡς τὸ παράπτωμα, οὕτως καὶ τὸ χάρισμα· εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι οἱ πολλοὶ ἀπέθανον, πολλῷ μᾶλλον ἡ χάρις τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἡ δωρεὰ ἐν χάριτι τῇ τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ εἰς τοὺς πολλοὺς ἐπερίσσευσεν.

controles.web: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.
controles.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
controles.livre: Mas o dom gratuito não é como a transgressão; porque, se pela transgressão de um, muitos morreram, muito mais a graça de Deus, e o dom pela graça de um homem, Jesus Cristo, têm sido abundantes sobre muitos.

versos.grego: καὶ οὐχ ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς ἁμαρτήσαντος τὸ δώρημα· τὸ μὲν γὰρ κρίμα ἐξ ἑνὸς εἰς κατάκριμα, τὸ δὲ χάρισμα ἐκ πολλῶν παραπτωμάτων εἰς δικαίωμα.

controles.web: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.
controles.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
controles.livre: E o dom não é como a transgressão de um que pecou; porque o julgamento de uma só transgressão trouxe condenação, mas o dom gratuito, de muitas transgressões, trouxe justificação.

versos.grego: εἰ γὰρ τῷ τοῦ ἑνὸς παραπτώματι ὁ θάνατος ἐβασίλευσεν διὰ τοῦ ἑνός, πολλῷ μᾶλλον οἱ τὴν περισσείαν τῆς χάριτος καὶ τῆς δωρεᾶς τῆς δικαιοσύνης λαμβάνοντες ἐν ζωῇ βασιλεύσουσιν διὰ τοῦ ἑνὸς Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ.

controles.web: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.
controles.kjv: For if by one man’s offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
controles.livre: Pois, se pela transgressão de um, a morte reinou por causa desse, muito mais os que recebem a abundância da graça, e do dom da justiça reinarão em vida por um só, Jesus Cristo.

versos.grego: Ἄρα οὖν ὡς δι’ ἑνὸς παραπτώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς κατάκριμα, οὕτως καὶ δι’ ἑνὸς δικαιώματος εἰς πάντας ἀνθρώπους εἰς δικαίωσιν ζωῆς·

controles.web: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.
controles.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
controles.livre: Portanto, assim como uma transgressão resultou em condenação sobre todos os seres humanos, assim também um ato de justiça resultou em justificação da vida sobre todos os seres humanos.

versos.grego: ὥσπερ γὰρ διὰ τῆς παρακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς ἀνθρώπου ἁμαρτωλοὶ κατεστάθησαν οἱ πολλοί, οὕτως καὶ διὰ τῆς ὑπακοῆς τοῦ ἑνὸς δίκαιοι κατασταθήσονται οἱ πολλοί.

controles.web: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.
controles.kjv: For as by one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
controles.livre: Pois, assim como pela desobediência de um só homem muitos foram feitos pecadores, assim também, pela obediência de um só, muitos serão justificados.

versos.grego: νόμος δὲ παρεισῆλθεν ἵνα πλεονάσῃ τὸ παράπτωμα· οὗ δὲ ἐπλεόνασεν ἡ ἁμαρτία, ὑπερεπερίσσευσεν ἡ χάρις,

controles.web: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;
controles.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
controles.livre: A Lei veio para que a transgressão aumentasse; mas onde o pecado aumentou, a graça superabundou;

versos.grego: ἵνα ὥσπερ ἐβασίλευσεν ἡ ἁμαρτία ἐν τῷ θανάτῳ, οὕτως καὶ ἡ χάρις βασιλεύσῃ διὰ δικαιοσύνης εἰς ζωὴν αἰώνιον διὰ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν.

controles.web: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
controles.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
controles.livre: a fim de que, assim como o pecado reinou para a morte, também a graça reine pela justiça para a vida eterna, por meio de Jesus Cristo, nosso Senhor.
